basic_info.description: Situated in the picturesque Forest Hill neighborhood sits this beautiful, fully-detached Mid-Century single family home. This inviting residence welcomes you with gorgeous parquet wood floors flowing throughout the living room, with oversized picture windows overlooking lush green outlooks, and a wood-burning fireplace. Continuing into the formal dining room, also framed by large picture windows brings ample light into this bright and open floor plan. Steps away, a charming eat-in kitchen with new Quartz countertops, SS-appliances, stylish two-tone cabinetry, and breakfast room overlooking the lovely backyard. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms complete this level, including a primary suite with renovated walk-in shower and access to the lovely landscaped backyard. Downstairs, a spacious 2nd living room/flex/game room for flexibility, plus an additional 3rd bedroom and 3rd full bath. A gorgeous backyard retreat is the perfect place to gather and entertain, with a spacious deck and new turf lawn, while surrounded by lush foliage. The oversized 1-car garage offers tons of additional storage and workshop area, plus additional driveway parking. This home feels tucked away like your private haven, while conveniently close to great parks, trails, playgrounds, and Forest Hill station.
